items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I used to play golf with his dad and his dad kept telling me about him so I hit him in an audition... Charlie will tell you, I was talking to Charlie the other day.

ctx.x: But I've had something in the situation.
I've had some bad, some bad moments, but that one, I let him talk his head off. But maybe I get abusive.

I was 16, I used to play golf with his dad and his dad kept telling me about him so I hit him in an audition and he floored me. Charlie Luckow? Charlie Luckow. His father was a fine gentleman, he died early in life, he was the head of a finance company. Charlie will tell you, I was talking to Charlie the other day. See I'm dead to lots of those fellas. Bob Young, my first sax man, I took him in the union when he was 16. And now there's nobody like me and I'm worried about him because he's not too well. I sent him…
